data.one_liner: A customizable countdown timer widget for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: It displays a countdown to a specified end time, supporting multiple formats and customizable text styles. The widget can show or hide unit descriptions and adjust spacing between numbers and colons.
use_when: You need a simple countdown timer in a Flutter app
You want to customize the appearance of the timer
You need to display or hide specific time units
avoid_when: You require advanced animation or physics-based motion
You need a timer that can pause, resume, or be controlled programmatically
strengths: Cross-platform support (Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, Linux)
Highly customizable text styles and spacing
Multiple predefined formats (days, hours, minutes, seconds)
weaknesses: Limited to countdown only, no stopwatch or timer start/stop control
